how security models can be used to improve the security of software systems.
the development of methods, models, and tools for security modeling and analysis.
how to combine and relate different security modeling techniques and how to support the use of these techniques through tools.

misuse cases and attack tree models complement each other and that they should be used in combination.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have presented a method for combining misuse cases and attack graphs to get a more complete picture of threats towards a system.
we have developed a framework for security requirements eliciting, analysis and modeling that is based on a set of interrelated models and tools.
the presented approach can be used to support security modeling throughout a system's life cycle.
The main takeaway from our work is that
security models are not stand-alone artifacts but rather part of a larger set of models that are used to describe the system and its security properties.
the combination of models can be used to provide a comprehensive security view of the threats to a system.
the combination of different models can help to increase security awareness in the development team and to improve the quality of the models themselves.
